mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment_image (user_id, file_path, original_name, file_size) VALUES (#{userId}, #{filePath}, #{originalName}, #{fileSize})
mapper.select: SELECT post_comment_image_id, user_id, file_path FROM post_comment_image WHERE post_comment_id IS NULL AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY ORDER BY post_comment_image_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_comment_image WHERE post_comment_image_id = #{postCommentImageId} AND post_comment_id IS NULL
